detail.longDescription:
I just wanted a local TTS tool to go along with Whisper. Somehow, I ended up experimenting with voice cloning on my almost 14-year-old PC...

I compiled audio.cpp with the Vulkan backend from source and tested the Audio8 TTS Preview 0.6B Q8_0 model.

The weird thing is that the generated voice kept changing between TTS runs. I started looking for a parameter to fix the speaker identity and stumbled upon voice cloning instead!

For my first test, I recorded a short reference sample of my own voice with my smartphone. For the second, I used a voice sample of Captain Janeway from a YouTube clip of the Star Trek: Voyager series finale, Endgame and made the model speak the exact same text.

I also edited and denoised the reference samples in Audacity before feeding them to the model.

The whole setup runs locally on Linux through Vulkan:

- Intel Core i5-650
- 8 GB DDR3 RAM
- AMD Radeon RX 570 with 4 GB VRAM

There are still some rough edges, though. Numbers don't always sound quite right and longer texts occasionally contain repeated words. Chunking the text might help with the latter, but I haven't tested that yet.
